Peaceful rush a plain guide to lounge space
Start here
Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways

Traveling with a pet should feel orderly, calm, and manageable. Our team coordinates care from booking through pickup, and we keep the guidance short enough to use at the counter, in the lounge, or on the move. If you are preparing to fly with a cat, dog, or other approved companion animal, this article explains the path in simple steps.

Before travel day, keep your documents together and make sure the carrier or crate is comfortable, clean, and secure. It helps to arrive with enough room to move through check-in without rushing your pet. Our staff will review the details, confirm the travel plan, and guide you toward the right next step if anything needs attention.

When a transfer is part of the journey, <<FACT F088>> Our staff will then continue the process with the same careful pace used throughout the trip, and we will keep the handoff smooth for the animal and the traveler.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk also supports boarding coordination. <<FACT F105>> Once that step is in place, the rest of the airport flow becomes easier to manage, because everyone involved can follow the same clear plan. We keep our instructions direct, and we aim to reduce waiting, confusion, and unnecessary handling.

During the airport visit, stay close to your pet's comfort needs. Offer water when allowed, keep the carrier steady, and follow any staff direction about movement through the terminal. If your pet seems unsettled, tell the nearest team member right away so we can adjust the pace and keep the situation calm. Travelers such as Khalil Clark and Layla Wilson have found that a steady routine helps both them and their animals feel settled.

After arrival, remain available for pickup steps and follow the release guidance given by the team. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and we work to make the final handoff as simple as possible.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways through the regular customer support channel.
